description.label: Store description
description.note: GOG supports EN, DE, FR, CN, PL and RU descriptions.

legal.label: Legal lines
legal.note: Copyright and trademark lines shown on the store page.

art.label: Key art (no logo)
art.note: GOG asks for key art and logo in high resolution (at least 1920×1080), ideally as a layered PSD; send these two layers

screenshots.note: Screenshots go to GOG through their Assets Manager with the other store assets.
